_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. xpFactor 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. The Z2 front captain: Vanguard at cL15, the deepest-gated teaching in the world. ⚑ TEXT SHAPE (PO 2026-08-02, on top of the Q4/R1 tree shape): teach text is deliberately plain — teaching behind a 'Teach me something.' row as a row that NAMES the skill directly; the war-banner briefing stays an answer-node. ⚑ QUESTS: offers and turns in `thin-the-orc-line` (plan-generic-kill-quests.md C2) behind its own root row — the punchy endgame cull on the elite Orcs his idle lore points at.

options.text: Do you have a task for me?
How do I bring down the Orc Commander?

lines: Kill 5 orcs on the front line south of here, then come back to me.

Break the banners in his camp west of here, then kill him.
